cohort: Eighty women with previous cesarean section who were candidates for VBAC
finding: VBAC can be considered as a safe maternal and neonatal delivery method in patients with past CS, with lower neonatal complications and higher breastfeeding rates.
mod_finding: VBAC can be considered as a safe maternal and neonatal delivery method in patients with past CS.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of neonates in successful VBAC was 2940 ± 768 grams and 3764 ± 254 grams in unsuccessful VBAC.
